overloadMerges.note: row accepts either a positive break/subtotal level or one of the documented negative sentinel constants (qr title/detail/grand total); modeled as sentinelValues. border is an additive bitmask of border-side constants, not a single enum value.

params.name: row
params.description: Row number of the cell, or a negative constant designating a special report area

sentinelValues.meaning: qr title -- title area of the report
qr detail -- detail area of the report
qr grand total -- grand total area

params.name: border
params.description: Composite (additive) value of the QR Borders theme constants indicating which side(s) of the cell to affect (e.g. left=1, top=2, right=4, bottom=8, inside vertical=16, inside horizontal=32); values can be summed to affect several borders at once.

params.name: line
params.description: Line thickness: 0=no line, 1=1/4 point, 2=1/2 point, 3=1 point, 4=2 points

params.name: color
params.description: Border line color; a positive value indicates a specific color, 0 is black

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets which border(s) of a given report cell are drawn, along with their line thickness and color.
